units.source_text: [3] 佛教中一种想象的神鸟。

en.t: [3] An imaginary sacred bird in Buddhism.

units.source_text: 人面鸟身，生活在雪山或极乐世界里，

en.t: It has a human face and a bird's body, and lives in the Snow Mountains or in the Pure Land,

units.source_text: 能发出美妙的声音，令人百听不厌。

en.t: and it can produce a beautiful voice that people never tire of hearing.

units.source_text: 此处指以此鸟命名的活动。

en.t: Here it refers to an event named after this bird.
